320	No matter how much a person tries, imagine what this is, it's beyond the grasp of
321	human
322	beings. This is what is meant by "all the life of this world": one hour
323	of contentment in the World to Come is better than all the life of this world.
324	"Contentment" means that you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, you only catch a little
325	whiff from outside of what is happening
326	inside. In Jerusalem there is the Angel bakery. Whoever walks
327	by the bakery usually walks more slowly. How
328	pleasant it is there. That is called contentment: "Better is one hour
329	of contentment in the World to Come than all the life of this world."
330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What
331	is the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of imagination. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with the eyes. But
334	in truth, matter is a kind of imagination.
335	Even in science they are starting to understand this. They know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	that are all packed one next
338	to the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there at the very finest
339	point? How many atoms are there? You have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	An inner nucleus and electrons that circle around it
343	at speed, and so they create the illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks solid, but it is not solid, it is only
347	because of the speed. Electrons move at speed
348	and create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	their motion? What would happen? The whole universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the true matter of the entire planet
354	Earth could fit into a matchbox. That is the
355	true matter that exists; all the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, say the masters
357	of the Kabbalah, the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination, but he enjoys because it suits the material.
